name: Jordan Levy
role: PhD Candidate at IRIT · Research Engineer at TwinswHeel
bio: I work on explainable anomaly detection for autonomous service robots. My research combines time series analysis, ensemble and multi-agent learning, and explainability methods such as SHAP to detect faults early and understand why they happen.

research.title: Anomaly detection
research.description: Detecting faults on mobile robots from multivariate sensor streams, online and on the edge.

research.title: Explainability
research.description: Using SHAP contributions to understand what anomaly detectors see and how they complement each other.

research.title: Time series
research.description: Interactive and multi-agent ensemble learning for time series classification.
